# Assistant Manager – Human Resources

## About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and people-focused HR professional to join our team as **Assistant Manager – Human Resources**. In this role, you will partner with business leaders to drive HR initiatives that support organizational growth, strengthen employee engagement, and cultivate a high-performance culture. You will play a hands-on role across the full employee lifecycle — from talent acquisition to employee relations and policy execution.

## Key Responsibilities

- Manage end-to-end talent acquisition, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates across functions and levels.
- Serve as a trusted point of contact for employee relations matters, resolving grievances and fostering a positive, inclusive workplace.
- Implement, communicate, and continuously improve HR policies and procedures in line with organizational goals and statutory requirements.
- Design and roll out employee engagement programs, recognition initiatives, and wellness activities to enhance workplace culture.
- Support performance management cycles, including goal setting, appraisals, feedback, and development planning.
- Collaborate with business leaders and department heads to understand workforce needs and provide strategic HR advisory support.
- Drive learning and development initiatives to support employee growth and career progression.
- Maintain accurate HR records, generate people analytics reports, and provide data-driven insights to leadership.
- Ensure compliance with labor laws, HR audits, and internal governance standards.
- Support HR transformation projects and contribute to continuous improvement of HR processes.

## Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).
- 4–7 years of progressive HR experience, with hands-on exposure to talent acquisition, employee relations, and HR operations.
- Strong understanding of HR policies, employment laws, and best practices.
- Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and handle sensitive employee matters with discretion.
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
- Proficiency in HRIS platforms and MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience partnering with business leaders as an HR generalist or HR business partner.
- Demonstrated success in designing and executing employee engagement or culture-building initiatives.
- Exposure to performance management frameworks and L&D program design.
- Knowledge of HR analytics and the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
- Certifications such as SHRM-CP, PHR, or equivalent are a plus.

## What We Offer

- A collaborative, people-first work environment where HR has a seat at the table.
- Opportunities to shape culture, influence strategy, and drive meaningful change.
- Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and clear career progression pathways.
- Continuous learning opportunities and professional development support.
